fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Jump infantry in League service exploit vertical mobility to compensate for the FWLM's sometimes fragmented command structure, seizing terrain that wheeled or tracked forces cannot reach. Their ability to operate across broken ground and urban environments makes them valuable in the border provinces where coalition territory changes hands frequently. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems, these platoons provide indirect fire capability that extends their engagement envelope well beyond personal weapons range, though the weight and bulk of the launchers reduce the platoon's mobility.
